# Smart Reply Feature — PRD

Title: Smart Reply
Owner: Someone

## Overview

We want to add an AI chatbot that helps users reply to messages faster. It will use AI to suggest replies.

## What it does

The feature suggests a reply when a user opens a message. Users can click the suggestion to send it or ignore it.

## Timeline

We hope to ship this soon, maybe next quarter.

## Notes

Should be pretty easy to build since we already use an LLM elsewhere in the app.
